questions.q: Why is "New Laptop Request" built as a standard catalog item rather than a Record Producer?
options: It needs to be tracked, approved, and assigned to a fulfillment task — the real work of the standard Request/Requested Item lifecycle, which a Record Producer would bypass
Record Producers cannot have a Choice variable
Standard catalog items are always required for hardware
A Record Producer cannot belong to a category
questions.explain: The request genuinely needs approvals and fulfillment-task tracking, which is exactly what the standard Request/Requested Item lifecycle provides and a Record Producer would discard.

questions.q: Why is "Laptop Model" built as a Choice variable instead of Single Line Text?
options: Choice variables are mandatory by default
So fulfillment always receives a real, mappable answer from a defined list of approved models, rather than unmappable free text
Single Line Text variables cannot be added to a catalog item
Choice variables automatically trigger a Record Producer
questions.explain: A Choice variable constrains the requester to valid, approved model options instead of arbitrary typed text.

questions.q: Why does the lab attach the existing "Requester Info" Variable Set instead of defining Manager and Cost Center variables directly on the new item?
options: Variable Sets are required by the platform for every catalog item
A catalog item cannot have more than two variables defined directly on it
Those fields aren't unique to laptops; reusing the shared set means this item inherits them (and any future fix) instead of becoming a third place to maintain a copy
Variable Sets disable the need for a Catalog UI Policy
questions.explain: This is the exact Lesson 12 principle: a variable identical across multiple items belongs in a shared Variable Set, not redefined per item.

questions.q: What does the Catalog UI Policy built in Step 4 actually do?
options: It deletes the "Business Justification" variable for premium models
It changes the item's category automatically
It converts the item into a Record Producer when a premium model is picked
It makes "Business Justification" visible and mandatory only when "Laptop Model" is one of the designated premium options
questions.explain: The condition checks the selected model; the action makes the justification variable required specifically for premium picks, solving the rubber-stamping problem with configuration.

questions.q: Where should the finished "New Laptop Request" item be filed, per Step 2 of the lab?
options: Under a sensible existing or newly created category such as "IT Equipment," rather than left in a flat uncategorized list
At the top level of the catalog, uncategorized, until a category is decided later
Inside the "Requester Info" Variable Set
On the catalog_ui_policy table directly
questions.explain: Lesson 11's category-hierarchy principle applies here: a new item should be filed under a sensible category, created first if it doesn't already exist, not dropped uncategorized.
